claims.claim: Born 14 November 2006 in Abiyán
claims.note: FotMob DOB Nov 14, 2006; La Libre 'natif d'Abidjan'.

claims.claim: Ivorian winger, 19 years old (26 Oct 2026)
claims.note: DOB gives 19 on 26 Oct 2026; La Libre says 19.

claims.claim: Best rookie of the Bundesliga 2025/26 playing for RB Leipzig
claims.note: Named 2025/26 Bundesliga Rookie of the Season, RB Leipzig.

claims.claim: Real Madrid announced signing 6 August 2026; contract until 30 June 2033
claims.note: beIN: Thursday, 6 Aug 2026, contract until June 30, 2033; Irish News confirms.

claims.claim: Contract is seven years
claims.note: beIN: 'after signing a seven-year contract'.

claims.claim: Went to the USA to study and play football; scouted at an international tournament
claims.note: La Libre quotes him: 'Je suis allé aux États-Unis pour étudier et jouer au football'; spotted at an international tournament.

claims.claim: Moved to Florida alone, without family; trained at a school and DME Academy in Daytona Beach
claims.note: Yulee High School and DME Academy, Daytona Beach.

claims.claim: MLS trials with Colorado Rapids and Charlotte FC, no contract; concluded the USA did not suit him
claims.note: La Libre: 'Les États-Unis ne me convenaient pas vraiment'.

claims.claim: Trials with Rangers (Oct 2023) and Olympiacos did not end in a signing
claims.note: Rangers trial October 2023, no signing; Olympiacos trial did not work out.

claims.claim: Joined Leganés from the USA for 1.5 million euros and signed first professional contract there
claims.note: La Libre: 'Arrivé des USA pour seulement 1,5 million d'euros'; first professional contract at Leganés.

claims.claim: First minutes late March at the Santiago Bernabéu before about 73,000
claims.note: La Libre: late March, Santiago Bernabéu, 73,000 spectators.

claims.claim: Leipzig bought him for 20 million euros the July after Leganés
claims.note: La Libre: resold to RB Leipzig the following summer for 20 million euros.

claims.claim: Coach Ole Werner quote: talent was not given to him, he already had it
claims.note: Werner: 'On ne lui a pas donné ce talent, il l'avait déjà.'

claims.claim: 12 goals and 8 assists in the Bundesliga season
claims.note: Bundesliga: 12 goals and eight assists; Africa Soccer: 12, 8 and 33 league appearances.

claims.claim: Attempted more dribbles and contested more duels than anyone in the league
claims.note: Bundesliga: 'attempted more dribbles than any other player in the division and contested the most duels'.

claims.claim: Africa Soccer: same figures in 33 league matches
claims.note: 33 league appearances.

claims.claim: Winning a league-high 437 duels; top ten in sprints, intensive runs and top speed; 'on his way to becoming a superstar'
claims.note: Article: 'winning a league-high 437 duels'; 'well on his way to becoming a superstar'; top 10 in the Bundesliga for the metrics.

claims.claim: Total across all competitions: 13 goals, 10 assists in 36 matches
claims.note: 13 goals, 10 assists, 36 appearances across all competitions.

claims.claim: Hat-trick vs Eintracht Frankfurt, matchday 13, 6-0; goals between minute 47 and 65, 18 minutes
claims.note: RB Leipzig 6-0 Eintracht Francfort, 13e journée; goals 47th to 65th minute, within 18 minutes.

claims.claim: Rookie eligibility: under 23 on matchday 1, no prior Bundesliga starts, under 450 minutes
claims.note: Rules stated as written.

claims.claim: Rookie of the Season chosen from the monthly Rookie of the Month winners; votes fans 40%, clubs 30%, experts 30%
claims.note: 'chosen from the selection of Rookie of the Month winners'; weights 40/30/30.

claims.claim: Final beat Luka Vušković (Hamburger SV) and Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen)
claims.note: 'Hamburg's Luka Vušković and Bayer Leverkusen's Ibrahim Maza'.

claims.claim: Result published 18 May 2026
Quote: 'una amenaza constante en las situaciones de uno contra uno'
claims.note: 'A constant threat in one-on-one situations' (translated).

claims.claim: Seven Man of the Match votes, article dated 22 December 2025
claims.note: Published 22.12.2025; 7 votes.

claims.claim: Among the 25 Golden Boy 2026 candidates; winner announced in November
claims.note: Named among the top 25; winner to be announced November 2026.

claims.claim: Missed the Saalfelden pre-season trip while recovering from an illness; now fit for 2026/27
claims.note: Recovered from illness; stayed behind at Saalfelden, now fit.

claims.claim: 3-0 win over Kenya on 14 October 2025 qualifying for the 2026 World Cup, first since 2014 (12 years)
claims.note: Tuesday 14 Oct 2025, 3-0; first World Cup since 2014.

claims.claim: Diomande scored in the 54th minute against Kenya
claims.note: Second goal, 54th minute.

claims.claim: World Cup debut vs Ecuador, Côte d'Ivoire won; aged 19 years 212 days; first teenager to play a World Cup match for the country
claims.note: 'À seulement 19 ans et 212 jours', first teenager per FIFA as cited by Fratmat.

claims.claim: Real Madrid announced the signing on Thursday 6 August 2026; beIN gives no fee
claims.note: Thursday, Aug 6; no transfer fee stated.

claims.claim: Press Association reported 115.8 million pounds, citing understanding, dated 6 Aug 2026
claims.note: '£115.8million'; dated 6 Aug 2026.

claims.claim: IANS reported around 130 million euros without naming an original source
claims.note: 'around 130 million euros (160 million U.S. dollars)'.

claims.claim: Sources do not confirm either fee from the club
claims.note: No club fee statement in the sources read.
